transcript: DAVID: Doesn't say who wrote it... It just says "You don't answer me... Maybe you can't hear me. Maybe you can't hear at all. But maybe you can read these words. I've been trying to set you free. Don't you understand that? We thought the ritual would win the war. But we were wrong. You didn't bring victory with you. You only brought your hunger. I'm sorry we woke you. I have been doing all I can to appease you... We have given you tribute after tribute to feed on... Isn't that what you wanted?"
